matches.expected_score: No precise probability originated for a 22-car field.
matches.inputs_summary: Championship leader by 102 points and the season's most successful driver with 7 Grand Prix wins; Mercedes drivers sit 1-2 in the standings. Form caveat: Max Verstappen won the last two races (Bahrain, Singapore).
matches.form_context: Kimi Antonelli 7 wins (Japan, Miami, Canada, Monaco, Belgium, Italy, Spain); George Russell 2 (Austria, Azerbaijan); Lando Norris 2 (Hungary, Netherlands); Max Verstappen 2 (Bahrain, Singapore - the two most recent races); Lewis Hamilton 1 (Barcelona-Catalunya); Charles Leclerc 1 (Great Britain). Season's most recent race: Singapore, 11 Oct, won by Verstappen.

outrights.basis: Leads the official standings with 340 points, 102 clear of George Russell (238), with the USA GP (25 Oct) and the remaining rounds to the Abu Dhabi finale (6 Dec) left to run. Not yet mathematically clinched; standings-leader basis.
